_about: Every outside resource the shared app relies on or was built from. status: cited = a starter list or number in the app comes from it; reference = background reading behind the original plan, not yet used in the app's lists. Clinician handouts are named by their publisher only (no clinic's copy linked) to keep any one person's care team private. Each starter-list rule names its source ids. build.py turns this into sources.html.
